frame.head:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a 9-slice game UI frame for a cute chibi kawaii pixel art vertical space shooter. A script will cut it into four corners, four edges and a center, and stretch the edges and center to any size, so the straight edges must be uniform.
Reference images: the first attached image is the game's art style sheet and the second shows the finished in-game characters. Match their pixel art style, dark navy outline and pastel candy colors so the UI feels like the same game.
The third attached image, when present, is the first finished frame of this UI set: match its pixel size, outline thickness, band thickness, corner rounding and level of detail exactly, changing only what the request says.
frame.style: Style/medium: crisp hard-edged square pixel art with chunky, clearly visible pixels, a limited flat palette, a thick soft dark navy outline, simple two-tone pixel shading (a light highlight line along the top and left inner edge, a slightly darker shade along the bottom and right inner edge). No anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.
frame.framing: Composition/framing: exactly one empty frame, seen flat and front-on, centered, filling most of the canvas with a clear margin of background on every side, nothing cropped, no perspective.
frame.constraints: Constraints: the background outside the frame is one flat solid pure green #00FF00 filling the canvas edge to edge. The frame itself uses no green at all. The interior of the frame is one single flat solid color with no texture, pattern or gradient, and is completely empty. All decorations sit only at the four corners; the four straight edges between the corners are plain and identical along their whole length.
frame.avoid: Avoid: text, letters, numbers, labels, icons or characters inside the frame, watermark, drop shadow, glow, bloom, sparkles floating outside the frame, a second frame.

icon.head:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a set of tiny game UI icons for a cute chibi kawaii pixel art vertical space shooter. Each icon will be cut out and shown very small (about 14 to 28 pixels), so every icon needs a bold simple silhouette that reads at low resolution.
Reference images: the first attached image is the game's art style sheet and the second shows the finished in-game characters. Match their pixel art style, dark navy outline and saturated candy palette so the icons belong to the same game.
icon.style: Style/medium: chibi kawaii pixel art, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky and simple, a clean dark navy outline around every icon, flat colors with one highlight and one shade, a tiny white glint. No anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.
icon.framing: Composition/framing: the icons are laid out exactly as described, each the same size, each centered in its own cell, with wide empty background space between icons so none of them touch, nothing cropped. Every icon is front-facing and flat, no perspective.
icon.constraints: Constraints: the background is one flat solid pure green #00FF00 filling the entire canvas edge to edge. The icons use no green at all (use teal or mint only if a request asks for it, never pure green). No frames, circles, badges or tiles behind the icons. No drop shadow, glow, aura or sparkles floating between icons.
icon.avoid: Avoid: text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, grid lines, extra icons beyond those requested, characters or faces.

art.head:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: pixel art illustration for a cute chibi kawaii vertical space shooter (portrait game screen). UI and text will be drawn on top by the game, so the image itself must contain no text.
Reference images: the first attached image is the game's art style sheet and the second shows the finished in-game characters (the blue jet with a chibi pilot girl, the Pico Drone robot girl, the pink twin-tail Gunner Girl, the purple armored Bulwark, the orange fox Kamikaze Kitsune, and the two bosses Crimson Seraph and Void Empress). Draw these same characters in the same style.
art.style: Style/medium: chibi kawaii pixel art matching the reference sheet: crisp hard-edged square pixels, clean dark outlines, saturated candy palette, big glossy anime eyes. Deep navy and purple space with small white and pastel pixel stars and soft pixel nebula clouds made of flat color bands (no smooth gradients).
art.constraints: Constraints: no text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no borders.
art.avoid: Avoid: watermark, signature, photo realism, 3D render, blur, lens flare, extra characters not in the references, revealing outfits.

badge.head:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: game title logo for a cute chibi kawaii pixel art vertical space shooter, shown on the title screen about 400 pixels wide.
Reference images: the first attached image is the game's art style sheet and the second shows the in-game characters. Match their pixel art style and candy palette.
badge.style: Style/medium: chunky pixel art lettering with crisp hard-edged square pixels, thick dark navy outline around every letter, two-tone candy shading (light highlight on top, darker shade at the bottom of each letter), a few tiny four-point pixel star sparkles. No anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur.
badge.framing: Composition/framing: the logo centered, filling most of the canvas width with a clear margin on every side, nothing cropped, flat front-on, landscape canvas.
badge.constraints: Constraints: the background is one flat solid pure green #00FF00 filling the canvas edge to edge. The logo uses no green at all. No drop shadow on the background, no glow, no scene behind the logo.
badge.avoid: Avoid: any words other than the requested text, misspellings, extra letters, watermark, characters, planets.
